content.rationale: The exclude interface is where the four-interface split meets the init bootstrap that writes the exclude file; the gate forces the exclude-file claim to answer to both without re-deciding the sequence. Its two edges span two cells — one prose parent (natural→natural) and one requirement-sentence parent (structured→natural) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
